scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I recently applied for a VA home purchase loan and I was wondering if you could provide me with an update on the status of my application? Also, could you tell me the interest rate I've been offered?
dialogue.agent: I'm sorry to inform you that your VA home purchase loan application has been denied. Unfortunately, the record does not include the specific interest rate offered, as the loan was not approved. The principal reason for the denial was due to credit history.

dialogue.user: I see. Could you please tell me what my debt-to-income ratio was at the time of the application? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio was 39% at the time of the application. Since your loan was denied, it has not been transferred or sold to another institution.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. I understand that my application was denied due to credit history. Is there any other reason that contributed to the denial? Also, are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: No, there are no additional reasons for the denial beyond credit history. The loan does not have any high-cost flags or negative amortization features.

dialogue.user:
I see. Thank you for the information. I'm a bit disappointed with the outcome, but I appreciate your help. I think that's all the questions I have for now.

<Dissatisfied>

The agent provided clear and polite answers, but I'm disappointed that my loan application was denied due to credit history. I was hoping for a more favorable outcome.
